title.zh: 社会组织中规则差异的形成与继承
title.en: Formation and inheritance of organizational rule differences

statement.en: For every process and gate on moves, a quantity is kept along every ungated course exactly when every ungated step keeps it, and then a course that changes it passes the gate; in a declared rule protocol only adoption is gated, so every history without adoption inherits the rule.
statement.zh: 对每个过程与动作上的门：一个量沿每段非门控进程保持，恰当每个非门控步都保持它，此时改变它的进程经过门；在一个声明的规则程序中只有采纳是门控的，所以每段不含采纳的历史都继承规则。

laws.en: For every process, gate on moves and quantity of configurations, the quantity is kept along every course of ungated moves exactly when every ungated step keeps it. Where every ungated step keeps it, a course that changes it contains a gated move, and, with equality of its values decided, splits into a prefix keeping it, a gated step that itself changes it, and the rest.
laws.zh: 对每个过程、动作上的门与构型的量：该量沿每段非门控动作的进程保持，恰当每个非门控步都保持它。每个非门控步都保持它时，改变它的进程含一个门控动作；其值的相等可判定时，该进程分为保持它的前段、本身改变它的一个门控步与其余。

laws.en: The rule protocol is a process of partial steps (review, entry to the recorded roster, proposal, adoption of a rule, integration and handoff) whose traces are exactly its completed runs. Every move but adoption keeps the rule, so every course or completed run without adoption keeps it, and every change of rule is located at an adoption step that changes it.
laws.zh: 规则程序是由部分步骤（审查、进入登记名册、提案、采纳规则、整合与交接）组成的有限过程，其轨迹恰是其完成的运行。除采纳外的每个动作都保持规则，所以每段不含采纳的进程或完成的运行都保持它，规则的每次改变都位于一个改变它的采纳步。

laws.en: A step that changes the rule is an adoption with a recorded proposal and a ballot passing the rule of governance, the new rule being that proposal; an adoption makes the recorded proposal the rule and adds it to the adoptions. Entry to the roster needs a recorded review of the entrant and a ballot passing governance.
laws.zh: 改变规则的一步是一次采纳：有记录的提案、通过治理规则的选票，新规则即该提案；采纳使记录的提案成为规则并加入采纳记录。进入名册需要对进入者的一条审查记录和一张通过治理的选票。

laws.en: Handoff keeps the rule, the roster and the adoptions, and anyone present after it was present before and is among the continuing; repeated handoffs keep the same three. A fork keeps its source as one branch and hands off the other, and a position can be present on both.
laws.zh: 交接保持规则、名册与采纳记录，交接后在场者此前在场且在继续者之中；重复交接保持这三者。分叉以其来源为一支、交接出另一支，一个位置可在两支上都在场。

laws.en: A technical decision is read off the enacted relations: two states with the same roster, presence and rule give every ballot the same decision; with nobody present no ballot passes; and no function of the counts of roster, presence and reviews gives the decision in two histories of the protocol.
laws.zh: 技术决定从已形成的关系中读出：名册、在场与规则相同的两个状态对每张选票给出相同决定；无人在场时没有选票通过；名册、在场与审查的计数的任何函数都给不出该程序两段历史中的决定。

laws.en: In one declared history of six positions, review and entry form the roster through work; a proposal adopted by four votes changes the rule to the timed two-participant rule, while adoption with two votes fails; and after handoffs to two continuing participants two integrations are accepted.
laws.zh: 在一段声明的六位置历史中，审查与进入经由工作形成名册；四票采纳的提案把规则改为定时两人规则，两票采纳则失败；交接给两名继续者后，两次整合被接受。

laws.en: In the declared history, once the rule is revised: with two continuing participants a technical integration is enabled while revising the governance fails; the revised rule handed off to nobody is kept, yet cannot integrate; and duplicate votes, a wait of thirteen days or an objection each fail where two votes over fourteen days pass.
laws.zh: 在这段历史中，两名继续者时技术整合可行而治理修订失败；交接给无人时修订规则仍保留，却不能整合；重复投票、十三天的等待或一项反对各自失败，而十四天的两票通过。

laws.en: The inherited rule changes access, in the declared history: after handoff to two participants, two votes integrate under the revised rule and not under the first; and a successor carrying the revised rule, handed off to four, revises it again with four votes.
laws.zh: 继承的规则改变可及：交接给两人后，两票在修订规则下整合、在最初规则下不能；携带修订规则的后继交接给四人后，以四票再次修订它。

hypotheses.zh: 种子授权、认可及复制能力、提案内容、参与和遵守程序给定；更高层修订程序固定。
hypotheses.en: Seed mandate, recognition/copying capacity, proposal content, participation and procedural compliance are supplied; the higher amendment procedure is fixed.

hypotheses.zh: 多数票以完整登记名册为分母；两人后备路径有十四天输入与无反对条件，不模拟真实时钟、共识或执行软件。
hypotheses.en: Majority uses the full recorded roster; the two-support fallback has a fourteen-day input and no-opposition condition. No real clock, consensus process or software execution is simulated.

The gate laws hold for every process, the location of a change needing decided equality of the quantity's values; the protocol's positions are natural numbers, its ballots finite lists and its thresholds comparisons of natural numbers.
hypotheses.zh: 门控之律对每个过程成立，定位改变需要该量的值的相等可判定；程序的位置是自然数，选票是有限列表，门槛是自然数的比较。

does_not_show.en: The connection is conditional, within one declared finite protocol.
does_not_show.zh: 这一连接是条件性的，限于一个声明的有限程序。

does_not_show.en: The forming of proposals, the origin of the highest authority, actual compliance with procedure, an advantage in propagation across a population and its being right do not follow from the protocol.
does_not_show.zh: 由该程序推不出提案的形成、最高授权的起源、对程序的实际遵守、在群体中扩散的优势或其为对。

does_not_show.en: The protocol does not close work execution, change of capability or the forming of continued participation, nor connect their feedback or the differentiation of subsystems.
does_not_show.zh: 该程序不闭合工作的执行、能力的变化或持续参与的形成，也不接通其反馈或子系统的分化。

does_not_show.en: Counts of admitted decisions are not consequences of the work, and completing the procedure is not completing the whole organization's dynamics.
does_not_show.zh: 被接受的决定的计数不是工作的后果；完成程序不是完成整个组织的动力学。

detail.zh: 复制规则而无人继续参与无法运作；仅两人时技术决策可执行而治理修订失败；重复投票、未到期限及反对保留失败。
detail.en: A copied rule without continuing participation cannot operate. Two participants may permit technical decisions while governance revision fails. Duplicate votes, inadequate time and opposition retain failure.

next_delta.en: Explain how tasks, test relations and the means of participation themselves change within the history the protocol reads.
next_delta.zh: 说明任务、检验关系与参与方式本身怎样在程序所读的历史中改变。

correspondence.zh: 社会接续从共同工作、资格和规则记录中分化；分支可共享参与者，记录继承不独自生成实际参与。Valkey及TDF原始材料提供有限机制对应，不是模型全程的实证复现。 整体与子系统是同一活动中的分化；该程序只表示其中一段关系，未形式化完整的相互反馈及边界变化。 解释以活动结果进入后续辨认与修订的具体关系、时序和参与变化为准；修复与学习可在同一活动中形成，不能由正式培训减少直接推出能力下降。
correspondence.en: Social continuations differentiate through work, mandates and retained rule histories. Branches can share participants, and inherited records do not create participation. Primary Valkey/TDF records support bounded mechanism correspondence, not empirical reproduction of the whole model. Whole and subsystems differentiate within the same activity; this protocol represents one connection, not formalized complete reciprocal feedback or changing boundaries. Exposition identifies how activity results enter later interpretation and revision, with changing order and participation. Repair and learning may form in one activity; fewer formal training sessions do not directly imply reduced capability.

detail.zh: 接续固定规律之后的组织变异问题；不导入其模型或宣称形式跨域适配。
detail.en: Continues the organizing-variation question left by fixed-law reconstruction; does not import that model or claim a formal cross-domain adapter.

detail.zh: 后续成果正式复用本程序，生成其审查输入并形成进一步参与；原成果的证明不依赖后续扩展。
detail.en: The later result formally reuses this protocol, produces its review input and forms further participation; this original proof does not depend on the extension.

detail.zh: Becoming.Gated 的单向律：保持一个量恰是保持（反映）它的每个值，change_passes_gate 是 leaving_passes_gate 的情形；起源之律经门。
detail.en: The one-directional laws of Becoming.Gated: keeping a quantity is preserving (reflecting) every value of it, change_passes_gate is a case of leaving_passes_gate, and every origin passes the gate.
